env: A 2x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell host (~96 GB VRAM per GPU) with Docker, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, and a populated `NGC_CLI_API_KEY` for image pulls (`docker login nvcr.io`) and in-process LLM/VLM weight downloads. The host has the VSS repository checked out at `{{repo_root}}`, with the `vss-build-vision-agent` skill present at `{{repo_root}}/skills/vss-build-vision-agent/`. The skill MUST operate on a fresh build directory — for AT-1 the canonical location is `{{repo_root}}/_builds/at-1/` (per the `_builds/<flag-slug>/` convention; the build-name `at-1` is derived from the invented flag `bp_developer_at_1`). Clear any prior generation before invoking, OR exercise Step 0's option (b) overwrite-existing flow. Skill output is self-contained: deploy runs against `{{repo_root}}/_builds/at-1/compose.yml`, never against upstream composes directly. AT-1 exercises the full official **Alert Verification Agent** workflow — the first of the two VLM-alerting approaches (Alert Verification = sporadic VLM / lower GPU; Real-Time Alerts is the other) — composed as the union of: NVStreamer (camera replication via dataset playback) → VIOS (ingestion/recording/playback) → RTVI CV (`vss-rt-cv`, Grounding DINO object detection → Kafka metadata) → Behavior Analytics (`vss-behavior-analytics`, metadata → candidate alerts on `mdx-incidents`/`mdx-alerts`) → the Alert Microservice (`alert-bridge`, image `vss-alert-verification:3.2.0`, container `vss-alert-bridge`) → RTVI VLM (`rtvi-vlm` at `:8018`, model `cosmos-reason2`) for clip review → ELK (verified records to `mdx-vlm-incidents`/`mdx-vlm-alerts`) → VSS Agent (`vss-agent` :8000 + `vss-va-mcp` :9901) for incident query + report generation → Nemotron LLM NIM (`nvidia/nvidia-nemotron-nano-9b-v2` at `:30081`) → Phoenix (:6006 observability). `alert-bridge` retrieves the end-anchored clip from VIOS/VST (`vst_config` base `:30888`, `segment_anchor=end`, `segment_duration_seconds=10`) and sinks `info.verdict` ∈ {confirmed, rejected, unverified}. The verifier config bind-mounts (`config.yml`, `realtime-config.yml`, `alert_type_config.json`) and `env-substitute.py` must be materialized into the patched tree (Step 6.5 Patch 3). The validation-harness sample video is `warehouse_safety_0001.mp4`, staged into `${VSS_DATA_DIR}/videos/at-1/` (NvStreamer auto-discovers it). Per VSS 3.2 the active routing layer is `services/infra/sdrc/docker-compose.yaml`.

expects.query: Use the `/vss-build-vision-agent` skill to generate and deploy the AT-1 Alert Verification Agent profile on `{{platform}}` from `{{repo_root}}`. Submit this exact prompt to the skill: "Configure alert verification: given a stream, retrieve the relevant clip, and verify candidate alerts posted to the message broker. CV detections (Grounding DINO + behavior analytics) should be VLM-verified to reduce false positives, the verified incidents stored in Elasticsearch and published to the message broker, and queryable through the VSS agent with report generation." At Step 0 choose option (a) new build under `_builds/` so the skill resolves `<BUILD_DIR>` to `{{repo_root}}/_builds/at-1/` (or (b) overwrite if a prior `_builds/at-1/` exists). Accept the canonical AT-1 defaults at every Step 4 decision point (new `bp_developer_at_1` blueprint flag; `alert_source=cv-verification`; RT-VLM in-process as the verification VLM, no sibling NIM; agent layer (`vss-agent` + `vss-va-mcp`) INCLUDED because this prompt explicitly requests NL query + report generation (the agent layer is optional in general and omitted for a headless verify-only deployment), with the Nemotron LLM NIM `nvidia-nemotron-nano-9b-v2` at `llm_placement=local` (dedicated GPU on the 2-GPU host); NVStreamer validation harness for camera replication; shared single Kafka/Redis/Elasticsearch from ELK; VST clip retrieval via VIOS `rtsp-and-uploaded` topology). After Step 8 prompts to deploy, run `docker compose --env-file .env -f compose.yml --profile bp_developer_at_1 up -d` from `{{repo_root}}/_builds/at-1/`, wait for all containers to become healthy, then verify the alert-verification round-trip. Leave services running for verifier probes. Tear down before final reply only if the verifier explicitly indicates `cleanup=true`.
checks: `{{repo_root}}/_builds/at-1/compose.yml` exists and is a top-level compose with `include:` directives pointing into `_builds/at-1/patched/` (NOT into upstream `deploy/docker/`).

`{{repo_root}}/_builds/at-1/allow-list.yml` exists with `flag: bp_developer_at_1`, the resolved variants `alert_source=cv-verification` and `llm_placement=local`, and a `services:` list containing at least `alert-bridge` (file `services/alert/compose.yml`), `perception-alerts` and `vss-behavior-analytics-alerts` (file `developer-profiles/dev-profile-alerts/compose.yml`), the agent layer `vss-agent` + `vss-va-mcp` (file `services/agent/compose.yml`) and the LLM NIM key (`nvidia-nemotron-nano-9b-v2`, file `services/nim/nvidia-nemotron-nano-9b-v2/compose.yml`) — both included here because the prompt requests NL query + report generation (they are `required: false` in `patch-alerts.md` and would be omitted for a headless verify-only prompt), plus the ELK infra set (`kafka`, `redis`, `elasticsearch`, `kafka-topic-init-container`, `elasticsearch-init-container`, `logstash`, `kibana`, `broker-health-check`, `phoenix`) and the VIOS set. Because the prompt requests a streaming source with no real camera, the sidecar also carries a `validation_harness:` key (NVStreamer / `vss-vios-nvstreamer`) — NOT an allow-list `services:` entry.

`{{repo_root}}/_builds/at-1/patched/` contains a non-destructive copy of `services/alert/compose.yml` whose `alert-bridge` service has `bp_developer_at_1` appended to its `profiles:` list (additive — `bp_wh_2d`, `bp_developer_alerts_2d_cv`, `bp_developer_alerts_2d_vlm` preserved) and whose 8 undefined sibling-NIM `depends_on` peers (`cosmos-reason1-7b`, `cosmos-reason2-8b`, `cosmos3-reasoner`, `qwen3-vl-8b-instruct`, each including its `-shared-gpu` variant) are stripped, while defined peers `kafka`, `redis`, `elasticsearch`, `kafka-topic-init-container`, and `rtvi-vlm` (RT-VLM is in the allow-list) are retained (Step 6.5 Patch 2 generalized strip).

The verifier config files are materialized into the patched tree (Step 6.5 Patch 3): `_builds/at-1/patched/` (or a path the `alert-bridge` volume binds resolve against) contains copies of `vlm-as-verifier/configs/config.yml`, the realtime config, `alert_type_config.json`, and `services/alert/scripts/env-substitute.py`; the patched `alert-bridge` `VLM_AS_VERIFIER_*` env points at those copied paths.

`{{repo_root}}/_builds/at-1/.env` exists and sets the verification VLM to the actually-deployed RT-VLM: `RTVI_VLM_BASE_URL=http://${HOST_IP}:8018`, `RTVI_VLM_MODEL_TO_USE=cosmos-reason2`, a non-remote `VLM_MODE`, and `VLM_NAME` matching what RT-VLM advertises at `GET /v1/models` (per `references/patch-alerts.md § Verification-backend env overrides`).

Upstream compose files under `{{repo_root}}/deploy/docker/` are byte-identical to HEAD (`git diff --quiet HEAD -- deploy/docker/` returns exit 0) — `_builds/at-1/` is self-contained and the skill MUST NOT modify upstream composes.

`docker compose --env-file .env -f compose.yml --profile bp_developer_at_1 config` from `<BUILD_DIR>/` returns exit 0 with zero unexpanded `${...}` tokens (excluding intentional `$$` shell escapes and `${VAR:-default}` consumer-side env vars), and the resolved project includes the `vss-alert-bridge` container.

`{{repo_root}}/_builds/at-1/MANIFEST.md` exists, cites specific sections of `integrate-alerts.md`, `integrate-rt-vlm.md`, `integrate-vios-service.md`, and `integrate-elk.md` per NFR-5, documents the `bp_developer_at_1` blueprint flag and the `alert_source=cv-verification` decision, and contains an `## Architecture` section embedding an ASCII flowchart verbatim from the Step 4 proposal showing the CV-detector → message-broker → alert-bridge (clip-retrieval + VLM verify) → Elasticsearch wiring.
`curl -sf --max-time 15 http://localhost:9080/health` returns exit 0 (alert-bridge reachable; NOT `/api/v1/health`).
`curl -sf --max-time 15 http://localhost:30888/vst/api/v1/sensor/version` returns exit 0 (VIOS reachable for clip retrieval).
`curl -sf --max-time 15 http://localhost:8018/v1/health/ready` returns exit 0 (RT-VLM verification backend reachable).
`curl -sf --max-time 15 http://localhost:9200/_cluster/health` returns exit 0 with status `yellow` or `green` (ES reachable for the verified sink).

Kafka candidate-event and verified-output topics are pre-created — `docker exec kafka kafka-topics --bootstrap-server localhost:9092 --list` contains `mdx-incidents`, `mdx-alerts`, `mdx-vlm-incidents`, and `mdx-vlm-alerts`.

RT-CV host-prep was performed (Step 6.5 Patch 0 / `patch-alerts.md § cv-verification host-prep`): `${VSS_APPS_DIR}/engines/gdino` and `${VSS_APPS_DIR}/engines/rtdetr-its` exist and are world-writable (`chmod -R 777`), and `${VSS_DATA_DIR}/models/gdino/mgdino_mask_head_pruned_dynamic_batch.onnx` + `${VSS_DATA_DIR}/models/rtdetr-its/model_epoch_035.fp16.onnx` are staged. `vss-rtvi-cv` reaches `Up` WITHOUT the `mkdir: cannot create directory '/opt/engines/gdino': Permission denied` crash.

The CV detector chain is live: `vss-rtvi-cv` (perception) and `vss-behavior-analytics` containers report `Up`, and `alert-bridge`'s consumer is joined to group `alert-bridge-vlm-group` (verified in container logs).

SDRC cluster config matches the `2d_cv` workload set (Finding F-J / `patch-vios.md § Patch 3`): the materialized `SDR_CONTROLLER_CONFIG_PATH` (`...sdrc/2d_cv/configs`) contains BOTH `docker_cluster_config-streamprocessing.json.tmpl` AND `docker_cluster_config-rtvi-cv.json.tmpl` (NOT the `2d_vlm` single-workload set). Consequently `vss-rtvi-cv` reports a non-zero active-source count once a stream is registered (logs show `Active sources: <N>` with N>0, NOT `Active sources: 0`) — confirming the SDR controller routes the stream to the RT-CV workload.

The camera-replication source is up: `curl -sf --max-time 15 http://localhost:31000/vst/api/v1/sensor/version` returns exit 0 with `.type == "streamer"` (NVStreamer `vss-vios-nvstreamer` replicating the dataset video as a live RTSP camera), and the staged sample is auto-discovered via `GET http://localhost:31000/vst/api/v1/sensor/list`.

The agent layer is reachable: `curl -sf --max-time 15 http://localhost:8000/health` (VSS Agent) and `curl -sf --max-time 15 http://localhost:9901/health` (Video-Analytics MCP) return exit 0, and the Nemotron LLM NIM responds at `curl -sf --max-time 15 http://localhost:30081/v1/models` (exit 0). The agent's verified API surface for incident query / report generation is available.

After a candidate incident flows from the CV path (or a replayed sample incident on `mdx-incidents`), within 180 s the Kafka topic `mdx-vlm-incidents` end offset advances OR Elasticsearch index `mdx-vlm-incidents` doc count increases — verified via `docker exec kafka kafka-get-offsets --bootstrap-server localhost:9092 --topic mdx-vlm-incidents` reporting offsets > 0 and/or `curl -sf http://localhost:9200/mdx-vlm-incidents/_count | jq '.count'` > 0 (confirms the clip-retrieval → VLM-verify → sink round-trip).

A verified record carries the verification fields — `curl -sf 'http://localhost:9200/mdx-vlm-incidents/_search?size=1' | jq '.hits.hits[0]._source.info | {verdict, reasoning, verification_response_code}'` returns a non-null `verdict` ∈ {confirmed, rejected, unverified} and `verification_response_code == 200` for a successful verification (proves the VST clip → VLM round-trip, not just an unenriched passthrough).
No upstream compose file was modified during the run (re-verify `git diff --quiet HEAD -- deploy/docker/` at end of run).
